```{r Species Distribution Maps — Baseline Mean Suitability}

# Convert once outside the map2() call to avoid repeated conversion overhead
Georgia_adm2_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(Georgia_adm2)

map_pairs <- purrr::map2(
    tif_files,
    sp_labels,
    function(tif_path, sp_label) {

        mean_rast        <- rast(tif_path)[[1]]
        names(mean_rast) <- "suitability"
        mean_rast        <- clamp(mean_rast, lower = 0, upper = 1)

        # exact_extract requires an sf object, not SpatVector
        zonal_df <- exactextractr::exact_extract(
            mean_rast,
            Georgia_adm2_sf,
            fun         = "mean",
            append_cols = "NAME_2",
            progress    = FALSE
        ) |>
            dplyr::rename(mean_suit = mean)

        Georgia_zonal <- Georgia_adm2_sf |>
            dplyr::left_join(zonal_df, by = "NAME_2")

        p_viridis <- ggplot() +
            tidyterra::geom_spatraster(data = mean_rast) +
            geom_sf(data = Georgia_adm2_sf, fill = NA, colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
            scale_fill_viridis_c(
                option   = "viridis",
                name     = "Suitability",
                limits   = c(0, 1),
                breaks   = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
                na.value = "transparent"
            ) +
            labs(
                title    = bquote(italic(.(sp_label))),
                subtitle = "Baseline mean habitat suitability"
            ) +
            .map_theme()

        p_zonal <- ggplot() +
            geom_sf(
                data      = Georgia_zonal,
                mapping   = aes(fill = mean_suit),
                colour    = "grey30",
                linewidth = 0.4
            ) +
            scale_fill_viridis_c(
                option   = "viridis",
                name     = "Mean\nsuitability",
                limits   = c(0, 1),
                breaks   = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
                na.value = "grey85"
            ) +
            labs(
                title    = bquote(italic(.(sp_label))),
                subtitle = "Baseline mean suitability by municipality"
            ) +
            .map_theme()

        list(viridis = p_viridis, zonal = p_zonal)
    }
)

distribution_maps_viridis <- purrr::map(map_pairs, "viridis") |> purrr::set_names(sp_labels)
distribution_maps_zonal   <- purrr::map(map_pairs, "zonal")   |> purrr::set_names(sp_labels)


EXPORT_DIR <- r"(C:\Users\ianpsheasmith\OneDrive - University of Florida\General - Georgia Ticks\Georgia_Ticks\Paper2_Data\Predictions\ESM_BRT_Updated_Predictions)"

purrr::walk2(
    distribution_maps_zonal,
    names(distribution_maps_zonal),
    function(plot, sp_label) {

        # Strip titles and legend from the existing plot at export time
        p_export <- plot +
            labs(title = NULL, subtitle = NULL) +
            theme(legend.position = "none")

        # Replace spaces with underscores for a clean filename
        filename <- file.path(
            EXPORT_DIR,
            paste0(stringr::str_replace_all(sp_label, " ", "_"), "_zonal.svg")
        )

        ggplot2::ggsave(
            filename = filename,
            plot     = p_export,
            device   = "svg",
            width    = 6,
            height   = 4,
            units    = "in"
        )
    }
)


# Genera used to classify mosquitoes
MOSQUITO_GENERA <- c("Aedes", "Culex", "Anopheles", "Culiseta")

is_mosquito <- function(sp_label) stringr::word(sp_label, 1) %in% MOSQUITO_GENERA

# ── Build a long sf object with mean suitability for all species ───────────────
# Reuses the same extraction logic, producing one row per municipality per species
zonal_long <- purrr::map2(
    tif_files,
    sp_labels,
    function(tif_path, sp_label) {

        mean_rast        <- rast(tif_path)[[1]]
        names(mean_rast) <- "suitability"
        mean_rast        <- clamp(mean_rast, lower = 0, upper = 1)

        exactextractr::exact_extract(
            mean_rast,
            Georgia_adm2_sf,
            fun         = "mean",
            append_cols = "NAME_2",
            progress    = FALSE
        ) |>
            dplyr::rename(mean_suit = mean) |>
            dplyr::mutate(species = sp_label)
    }
) |>
    dplyr::bind_rows() |>
    dplyr::left_join(Georgia_adm2_sf, by = "NAME_2") |>
    sf::st_as_sf()

# ── Split into mosquito and tick subsets ──────────────────────────────────────
mosquito_long <- zonal_long |> dplyr::filter(purrr::map_lgl(species, is_mosquito))
tick_long     <- zonal_long |> dplyr::filter(!purrr::map_lgl(species, is_mosquito))

.build_facet_panel <- function(data_long, strip_fill = "grey95", ncol = 4) {

    data_long <- data_long |>
        dplyr::mutate(species = stringr::str_replace(species, " ", "\n"))

    ggplot(data_long) +
        geom_sf(aes(fill = mean_suit), colour = NA) +
        scale_fill_viridis_c(
            option   = "viridis",
            limits   = c(0, 1),
            breaks   = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
            na.value = "grey85",
            guide    = "none"
        ) +
        facet_wrap(~ species, ncol = ncol) +
        theme_void(base_size = 11) +
        theme(
            strip.background = element_rect(fill = strip_fill, colour = "grey70",
                                            linewidth = 0.5),
            strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold.italic", size = 7.5,  # reduced from 8.5
                                            lineheight = 1.15,
                                            margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 3, b = 3,
                                                                     l = 6, r = 6)),  # wider l/r padding widens boxes uniformly
            strip.clip       = "off",
            panel.border     = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "grey70",
                                            linewidth = 0.5),
            panel.spacing    = unit(0.25, "cm"),   # reduced from 0.5
            plot.margin      = ggplot2::margin(4, 4, 4, 4)  # reduced from 8
        )
}

# ── Reassemble with corrected groupings ───────────────────────────────────────
mosquito_figure <- .build_facet_panel(mosquito_long, strip_fill = "#e6f2ff")
tick_figure     <- .build_facet_panel(tick_long,     strip_fill = "#e6ffe6")

mosquito_figure
tick_figure

# ── Export ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
purrr::walk2(
    list(mosquito_figure,     tick_figure),
    c("mosquito_zonal_panel", "tick_zonal_panel"),
    function(fig, fname) {

        n_panels <- if (stringr::str_detect(fname, "mosquito")) {
            length(unique(mosquito_long$species))
        } else {
            length(unique(tick_long$species))
        }

        ggplot2::ggsave(
            filename = file.path(EXPORT_DIR, paste0(fname, ".svg")),
            plot     = fig,
            device   = "svg",
            width    = 14,
            height   = ceiling(n_panels / 4) * 4.5,
            units    = "in"
        )
    }
)
```
